method: Analytical radius-55 sphere and y rotation matrices; actual image matcher and fitted sphere. Six independently rendered front-facing body landmarks are lifted from the source image using the fitted model, propagated through all returned adjacent measurements, and compared with independent analytical image coordinates. Failed chains are never interpolated.
limitations: Synthetic development controls, not held-out author/conveyor, defect or grade accuracy. Stationary and uniform scenes contain no turn; numerical coverage cannot establish physical accuracy. A successful short-motion control does not validate complete-turn integration.
